minimal_data_allowlist.held_records: No authoritative paper/taxonomy data changes for R138,R154,R161,R187,R231.

Use canonical strings method;dataset;benchmark, method;benchmark, method;dataset. Main is the canonical paper-level track spelling.

preservation_and_collision_policy.native_id_algorithm: review: + sha256('|'.join(clean(field).casefold() for field in (review_queue,target_type,doi,openalex_url,title,year,institution)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]; clean collapses all whitespace.
preservation_and_collision_policy.collision_response: If any existing native ID collides with a nonidentical proposed row, stop and report it; do not rewrite a prior decision or falsify identity/queue/institution to force a new ID.
preservation_and_collision_policy.preserve_prefix: After appending, raw_after.startswith(raw_d109) must be true, parsed first 127 rows identical, exactly 11 new unique native IDs, all 138 IDs unique.
preservation_and_collision_policy.writer_note: review_decisions._write rewrites the complete registry on an actual change. Current bytes round-trip identically through its writer, but a controlled byte append plus strict prefix proof is safest. Identical native upsert short-circuits without writing.
preservation_and_collision_policy.csv_token_preservation: papers.csv and paper_taxonomy.csv contain 16 embedded CRLF sequences each. Reuse logical_csv_chunks / replace_csv_tokens semantics from tests/test_corpus_quality_batch_b_wave_b1n.py; preserve all unauthorized token bytes, row order, headers and unrelated row bytes.

action_fingerprints.note_token: [b4-03-state:<binding_sha256>] plus B3 matrix and per-record hashes and the preserved evidence path.
action_fingerprints.uniqueness: Include original review ID and action scope/queue. R231 and P231 share one paper/evidence packet but need different IDs and binding hashes. A shared evidence hash is never a unique action key.
action_fingerprints.venue_token: For accepted P231 only, [venue-state:<confirmation_fingerprint(post-change source)>] can confirm the bounded current venue state. Do not add venue-state tokens to resource-label decisions. If P231 is held, bind before state and do not mark terminal.

acceptance_and_idempotence_gates: One exact live row per new native ID, matching the manifest formal_decision and the native ID recomputed from existing helper semantics.
Correct review queue, target type, action, creator, original-review note prefix, timestamp format, canonical identity, B3 hashes, binding hash and note token.

For resource accepts: both existing paper compatibility field (where present) and authoritative taxonomy contain exactly the accepted types; reviewed statuses remain reviewed; primary_paper evidence tier and nonempty reason/source/excerpt match preserved evidence; exact approved cells only.
For R564: resolve the DOI taxonomy_id directly or through PaperIdentityIndex; public paper has no paper_id and there is no paper CSV row. Never index by blank paper_id.

For P231: accept only when Main reproduces the independently checked standalone-event semantics at the public boundary; source venue identity/name/acronym/type and all bibliographic fields remain byte-stable. Otherwise persist unresolved with no track edit.
For holds: accepted=false, accepted_changes=null, action=unresolved, hold disposition/limitations explicit, no canonical identity or author replacement, and every held data row byte-stable.

Negative tests must reject wrong native ID, wrong queue/action/creator, identity mismatch, missing/hash-tampered B3 or binding token, wrong resource types or evidence state, and unsupported/changed P231 track semantics.

Copy the final registry into a temporary file, call real upsert_review_decision twice per proposed formal row, and assert same row, byte-identical file, unchanged timestamps and 138 total unique IDs. Never call actual registry upsert during a read-only preflight.

accounting.method: Keep immutable original Batch B ledger (159 actions/148 papers). Recognize only no_action_after_review with original Batch B review token, plus two explicit B1O legacy native IDs. Reject duplicate terminal review IDs. Count unresolved original rows after removing terminal IDs; independently count distinct paper IDs; active subset uses preferred public IDs resolved through taxonomy identities.
accounting.shared_paper_warning: Closing P231 never closes unresolved R231 on the same paper. All 11 assigned actions are active-public at d109.
